summary: Full task spot-audit found one major and two minor original-task defects: inexact history crisis-state construction changes real D features; history normalization retains a superseded upper-component gate; and an excluded January-2026 label re-enters base category history and changes a wider-cohort prediction. The 20 focused tests pass, saved-model predictions and all reported nonempty metrics/90 bootstrap contrasts reproduce, and later commits only archive the task. V2 build/calibration lineage and affirmative realized-weather provenance remain material evidence gaps, so numerical reproducibility does not establish full acceptance.
